title: agent-blast-radius: harness, trial records and analysis for "When an AI agent makes a mistake in a database, what decides the damage?"
description: Harness (MIT), all confirmatory trial records with per-turn model reasoning (Layer B: 9,468 trials on nine engines, plus 2,916 trials on three extended engines), Layer A cells (934), replay-drill records, analysis scripts and the pinned analysis container definition. Preregistration: https://osf.io/ms7ef. All data is synthetic and was generated locally.
